slides.texte_overlay:
things confident people do
without noticing

disagreeing calmly

they can disagree with someone without immediately taking it back to avoid an argument. they say what they think, kindly, and then they calmly let it stand.

handling silences

they let pauses happen in a conversation instead of rushing to fill every gap. silence doesn't scare them, and that calm makes them easy to be around.

finishing their sentences

they end their thoughts clearly instead of trailing off with you know or whatever. finishing a sentence properly makes everything they say sound sure.

having unexpected topics

they don't only talk about the weather or work. they always have one strange story or surprising fact ready that makes the whole conversation come alive.
slides.texte_sophia:
having unexpected topics

they always have an unexpected topic ready. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, a myth or an odd fact, and suddenly every conversation comes alive.

slides.texte_overlay:
not announcing their nerves

they don't tell everyone how anxious they are before doing something. they feel the nerves, and then they simply do it anyway without making any scene.
